svg.title: Use it in three steps: download index.html or clone the repo; open it in Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge or Brave; click the pencil next to the greeting to set your name. Nothing to install and no account; search and DOI lookup need an internet connection. Privacy: there is no server and no tracking. Tasks, notes, reading list and focus history live only in your browser's localStorage. When you search, the query goes straight from your browser to the public Wikipedia and OpenAlex APIs. MIT license.

section.div: no install, no account, no server
section.h2: Open one file. That's the setup.

div.span: Download index.html, or clone the repo.
Open it in your browser: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge or Brave.
Click ✎ next to the greeting to set your name. Then press / and search.

div.div: Search and DOI lookup need an internet connection. MIT license.
